Definition: of uncertain affinity; to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.
BiblicalUsage: To the Thessalonians Paul writes not to sleep as others do but to watch and be sober, and to put on the breastplate of faith and love as those who belong to the day. Peter warns that the devil walks about as a roaring lion, and Timothy is told to watch in all things and endure afflictions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sober is the watchword of the last days: the watcher stays awake, the breastplate stays on, and the lion finds no sleeping prey. I must be sober because the night is far spent and the day is at hand.
